name: Amaike Mami
source:
Born on February 20, 1990.
Member of the Tennis club. Has a distinctive shaggy ponytail. She's a fan of someone named "Matsujon." She's very talkative, and is good friends with Natsusawa Remi and Shirakoma Kumi, often seen hanging out together.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
